hero.secondary: Two years at NAV IT building Norway’s public pension calculator. Trade certificate in IT development, passed with distinction. Now in the preparatory engineering year at NTNU, aiming for Cybernetics and Robotics.

items: Building kiln, the successor to Foundry.
Extending Propagator toward guidance and navigation.

talks.title: Perspektiver på IT-utviklingslærlinger i offentlig sektor
talks.summary: Apprenticeships as a path into software development in the public sector, from the apprentice’s side and the engineering lead’s.

primary.name: Oxidize
primary.purpose: Real-time voxel rendering as a performance study.
capabilities: Infinite chunk streaming around a fly camera, with 32³ voxel chunks generated on worker threads.
Neighbour-aware face culling and ambient occlusion, with meshes rebuilt in parallel.
Procedural terrain with biomes, oceans and caves, drawn with frustum culling and a separate transparent pass.
primary.evidence: Renderer prototype. Player physics and block editing are not built yet.

primary.name: Foundry
primary.purpose: Self-hosted CI/CD, end to end. Archived, succeeded by kiln.
capabilities: Pipelines declared in Forgefile, a small DSL with its own lexer, parser and validator.
Webhook-driven builds from a PostgreSQL job queue, run in isolated Docker containers.
Routes domains through Cloudflare, keeps secrets in Vault, and deploys itself.
primary.evidence: Deployed itself and six services to a Mac Mini M4.

foundational.name: Propagator
foundational.purpose: A small rigid-body state propagation core.
capabilities: Rigid-body state with quaternion attitude and body/world frame transforms.
Pluggable force models and environments; gravity on a flat earth so far.
foundational.scope: Rust library, early: gravity and semi-implicit Euler only
foundational.evidence: Drag, thrust and higher-order integration are not implemented yet.

foundational.name: N-Body
foundational.evidence: Numerical behavior observed over extended runs

foundational.name: Neural-Nets
foundational.evidence: Training behavior observed through loss convergence

foundational.name: Deadreckon
capabilities: Proportional navigation under realistic sensor degradation
Monte Carlo exploration across engagement geometries
foundational.scope: Rust workspace with simulation core, CLI, and visualization
foundational.evidence: Evaluated across six engagement scenarios with configurable noise profiles

infrastructure.summary: This site builds on GitHub Actions and deploys to Cloudflare Pages.

work.description: Pensjonskalkulator, Norway’s public pension calculator: React and TypeScript frontend, Kotlin services, Sanity, and CI/CD. Led the migration from Cypress to Playwright across 11 end-to-end suites, with sharding and multi-browser runs in CI. Before that, built the Kotlin backend of an internal apprentice product.
Part-time, alongside the apprenticeship. One-to-one support for people with special needs.
Short placements: data analysis at Visma, cloud and OpenAI API prototypes at Intility, a Vue.js frontend at Glasspaper.
Teaching programming to children through hands-on projects.

education.result: Subject average 5.86 · grade 6 in 12 of 14 subjects · practical exam 6

contact.note: Open to internships, student teams, and conversations about software in aerospace and autonomous systems.
